name: O-R10N
description: O-R10N was a blue astromech droid who served as Jessika Pava's astromech in the Resistance. During Black Squadron's mission to Megalox, O-R10N assisted in Operation Upside alongside BB-8, R2-HA, and R4 in an attempt to free Grakkus the Hutt until it was destroyed by an unidentified droid.
